definitions.explanation: A medical device or procedure for delivering fluids or medication directly into a vein through a tube.

examples.japanese: {脱水症状|だっすいしょうじょう}で{点滴|てんてき}を{打|う}った。
examples.english: I was put on an IV drip due to dehydration.

examples.japanese: {入院中|にゅういんちゅう}は{毎日|まいにち}{点滴|てんてき}を{受|う}けなければならなかった。
examples.english: During my hospital stay, I had to receive an IV drip every day.

notes:
USAGE:
The most common verbs used with {点滴|てんてき} are {受|う}ける (to receive) and {打|う}つ (to administer/get). In casual speech, {点滴|てんてき}を{打|う}つ is used from the patient's perspective.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {点滴|てんてき}を{受|う}ける: to receive an IV drip
- {点滴|てんてき}を{打|う}つ: to get an IV drip
- {点滴|てんてき}を{入|い}れる: to put in an IV
- {点滴|てんてき}{注射|ちゅうしゃ}: intravenous injection

ETYMOLOGY:
Literally "drip by drop" — {点|てん} (drop/point) + {滴|てき} (drip/drop).
